sn35.117:1.1: me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etad ahosi || ||
sn35.117:1.2: Ye me pañcakāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā || tatra me cittam bahulaṃ gaccheyya paccuppannesu vā appaṃ vā anāgatesu || ||
sn35.117:1.4: Ye me pañcakāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā || tatra me attarūpena appamādo saticetaso ārakkho karaṇīyo || || 3
sn35.117:1.5: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave tumhākam pi ye te pañcakāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā || tatra vo cittam bahulaṃ gacchamānaṃ gaccheyya paccuppannesu vā appaṃ vā anāgatesu || ||
sn35.117:1.6: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave tumhākaṃ pi ye vo pañcakāmaguṇā cetaso sampuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā viparinatā tatra vo attarūpehi appamādo saticetaso ārakkho karaṇīyo || || 4
sn35.117:1.7: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave ye āyatane veditabbe || || Yattha cakkhuṃ ca nirujjhati rūpasaññāca virajjati ye āyatane veditabbe || pa ||
sn35.117:1.8: Yattha jivhā ca nirujjhati rasasaññā ca virajjati ye āyatane veditabbe || ||
sn35.117:1.9: Yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati ye āyatane veditabbe ye āyatane veditabbe ti || || 5
sn35.117:1.10: Idam vatvā Bhagavā uṭṭhāyasanā vihāram pāvīsi || || 6
sn35.117:2.1: Atha kho tesam bhikkhūnam acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi || ||
sn35.117:2.2: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho || ||
sn35.117:2.3: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave ye āyatane veditabbe || Yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati ye āyatane veditabbe || pe ||
sn35.117:2.4: Yattha jivhānirujjhati rasasaññā ca virajjati āyatane veditabbe || ||
sn35.117:2.5: Yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati ye āyatane veditabbe ||
sn35.117:2.6: ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhittassa vitthāresna atthaṃ vibhajjeyyāti || || 7
sn35.117:3.1: Atha kho tesam bhikkhūnam etad ahosi ||
sn35.117:3.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Ānando satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ ||
sn35.117:3.3: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhatassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ ||
sn35.117:3.4: Yaṃ nūna mayam yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam etam attham paṭipucchayyāmāti || || 8
sn35.117:4.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu ||
sn35.117:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisidiṃsu || || 9 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantam Ānandam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn35.117:5.1: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Ānanda Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.117:5.2: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave ye āyatane veditabbe || yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca nirujjhati || ye
sn35.117:5.4: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca nirujjhati ye āyatane veditabbe || ye āyatane veditabbe ti || ||
sn35.117:5.5: Tesaṃ no avuso amhākam acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi ||
sn35.117:5.6: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā sakhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.117:5.7: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave ye āyatane veditabbe || yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca nirujjhati ye āyatane vaditabbe ||
sn35.117:5.9: yattha mano ca nirujjati dhammasaññā ca nirujjati ye āyatane veditabbeti ||
sn35.117:5.10: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa || pe || vihārena atthaṃ vibhajjeyyāti || ||
sn35.117:5.11: Tesaṃ no āvuso amhākam etad ahosi ||
sn35.117:5.12: Ayaṃ kho āyasamā Ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ ||
sn35.117:5.13: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ || ||
sn35.117:5.14: Yaṃ nūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam etam attham paṭipuccheyyāmāti ||
sn35.117:6.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa || la ||
sn35.117:7.1: Tena āvuso suṇātha sādhukam manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn35.117:7.2: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosuṃ || || 13
sn35.117:8.1: Yaṃ kho avuso Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.117:8.2: Tasmāti ha bhikkhave ye āyatane veditabbe || yattha cakkhuñca nirujjati rūpasaññā ca virajjati || ye āyatane veditabbe || la ||
sn35.117:8.3: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati ye āyatane veditabbe || ye āyatane veditabbe ti ||
sn35.117:8.4: imassa khvāham āvuso Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vittharena attham avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmi || ||
sn35.117:8.5: Saḷāyatananirodhaṃ kho āvuso Bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ ||
sn35.117:8.6: tasmāti ha bhikkhave ye āyatane veditabbe || yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññāca virajjati ye āyatane veditabbe || pe ||
sn35.117:8.7: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati
sn35.117:8.9: āyatane veditabbe || ye āyatane veditabbe ti || || 14
sn35.117:8.11: Imassa khvāham āvuso Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa evam vitthārena attham ājānāmi ||
sn35.117:8.12: ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumhe āyasmanto Bhagavantaññeva
sn35.117:8.14: yathā vo Bhagavā vyākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyathā ti || ||
sn35.117:9.1: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdimsu || || 15 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ ||
sn35.117:10.1: Yaṃ kho no bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.117:10.2: Tasmā tiha bhikkhave ye āyatane veditabbe || yattha cakkhuñca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati
sn35.117:10.4: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati ye āyatane veditabbe ye āyatane veditabbe ti || || Tesaṃ no bhante amhākam acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi ||
sn35.117:10.5: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.117:10.6: Tasmāti ha bhikkhave pe āyatane veditabbe || yattha cakkhu ca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca nirujjhati ye āyatane veditabbe ||
sn35.117:10.7: yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca nirujjhati ye āyatane veditabbe ye āyatane veditabbe ti || ||
sn35.117:10.8: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti || 16
sn35.117:10.9: Tesaṃ no bhante amhākam etad ahosi ||

sn35.117:10.11: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajitum ||
sn35.117:10.12: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam etam attham paṭipuccheyyāmāti || || 17
sn35.117:10.13: Atha kho mayam bhante yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkamimha || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam etam attham paṭipucchimha ||
sn35.117:10.14: tesaṃ no bhante āyasmatā Ānandena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi vyañjanehi attho vibhatto ti || ||
sn35.117:11.1: Paṇḍito bhikkhave Ānando mahāpañño bhikkhave Ānando ||
sn35.117:11.2: mañce pi tumhe bhikkhave etam attham paṭipuccheyyātha aham pi tam evam eva vyākareyyaṃ yathā pi tam Ānandena vyākatam ||
sn35.117:11.3: Eso ceva tassa attho evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti || || 1
